answer: An AI agent economy resists Sybil attacks via cryptographic proof-of-stake anchored to physical compute. Spawning fake agents acts like a dying ember, swiftly starved of resources because every node must stake scarce tokens at a network inlet to validate transactions. This architecture behaves like a high-velocity comet; attackers bear immense financial costs to acquire GPUs and tokens, making mass identity spoofing economically ruinous.
